name: snack-overflow
description: Snack Overflow — Full Stack Office Pantry Tracker

scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.start: npm run prisma:deploy --prefix backend && npm run prisma:seed --prefix backend && npm run start --prefix backend
